text:
Type: off-white swing-arm floor reading lamp
Use: reading light beside a sofa, armchair or desk; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: farmhouse, industrial, retro
Materials: off-white powder-coated steel, brass-tone details, braided textile cord
Colors: off-white, brass, grey cord
Shape: tall pole with a long counterbalanced horizontal arm, dome shade on one end, brass pivot joint and socket, round heavy base, linear and graphic, medium visual weight
Feel: nostalgic, warm, crafted, focused
Goes with: warm wood, linen, white walls, brass accents; farmhouse, Scandinavian or vintage-style living rooms and studies

product.name: RANARP
product.description: You can easily direct the light where you want it because the lamp arm and head are adjustable.
